messages:
sarah.c: Heads up — ACME (acct acme-42) embedding calls are up 3.8x over the last 7d vs baseline. QBR in 8 business days; want a clear spend forecast + renewal risk note. TL;DR: projected month burn ~42M tokens. Need: budget alert, enablement for their ML team, and a short cost-savings playbook.

devon: Can you split prod vs non-prod and drop a quick 30d number? Also any customer sentiment on this?

samir: Quick query I ran (raw):

```sql
SELECT env, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account='acme-42' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY env;
```

samir: Results: prod 38M tokens, staging 4M tokens last 30d. Prod spike aligns with a new batch embed job kicked off last Wed.

ellie: Proposal: set non-prod quota to a low throttle and create an 80% budget alert for prod. ops-bot, can you spin the alert? :warning:

ops-bot: [Alert Created] budget_alert:acme-42:80pct — notifications sent to @sarah.c @devon @ellie

devon: Good. For the QBR we need: current burn, 3- and 6-month forecast, risk level (medium-high), and two mitigation knobs (prefix caching and recommend quantized model). Do we need eng support to implement throttles?

samir: Eng ask: add per-key throttle for batch embeddings (tokens/min). I can draft throttle values. If we target 50% throughput reduction that should buy runway and avoid immediate SLA impacts.

sarah.c: Let's aim for 50% on batch jobs for now. Samir — please draft throttle + rollback plan by EOD Fri. Ellie will own the QBR slide deck and feedback capture. Devon will prep renewal talking points.

ellie: I'll also reach out to their ML lead to capture why the backfill ran and add that to the deck as a feedback item. Will include two scenarios: no action vs 50% throttle and the estimated spend delta.

devon: Action items:
- samir: throttle proposal + rollback steps (due EOD Fri)
- ellie: QBR slide draft + feedback template (due Mon)
- sarah.c: schedule enablement call + list quick wins to reduce tokens (due Mon)

sarah.c: One more: surface $ impact using placeholder price $0.0006 / 1k tokens so stakeholders can see $ figures.

samir: Quick math: 42M tokens/mo = 42,000k tokens. At $0.0006 per 1k => ~$25.2k/mo. With 50% throttle on the batch portion (assuming batch = 30M of that), rough delta is ~$9k–12k/mo. I'll put exact calc in the deck.

ellie: I'll add an appendix with the exact token queries + a short how-to for them to monitor embedded-job runs (copyable commands).

devon: Once slides are uploaded ping me and I'll schedule a 30m rehearsal with the CSM + AE.

sarah.c: Thanks all. tagging ops-bot to keep watching for anomaly patterns and auto-open triage if needed. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Will create a triage thread if we detect >2x day-over-day change and escalate to @devon.
